paper_title: Searching for solar axions using data from the Sudbury Neutrino Observatory
coupling_convention: GeV^-1 (isovector g^3_aN = (gan-gap)/2, applied to gan assuming no cancellation)
notes: Solar axion search via deuteron dissociation at SNO. Constrains isovector axion-nucleon coupling g^3_aN = (gan-gap)/2 > 2e-5 GeV^-1 (95% CL) for axion masses up to ~5.5 MeV, with upper bound from solar trapping at ~1e-3 GeV^-1. Note this coupling is in GeV^-1 (derivative coupling normalization), NOT dimensionless. Lower edge of exclusion band is flat at 2e-5 GeV^-1 across the full mass range; upper edge at ~1e-3 GeV^-1. Data points given here are the lower (most sensitive) boundary. Equivalent to gan limit assuming no cancellation between gan and gap.
